summary.en: The one hand-drawn thing in a clean diagram: a part as a rough outline and hachure on a light backing with its title, or a smooth loop pill that becomes a circle; same seed, same strokes.
summary.zh: 干净图里唯一手绘的东西：部件画成粗糙轮廓加排线、浅底、带标题；或光滑的循环药丸，放大成圆；同一种子同一笔画。

fits: Parts of a system in an overview or a detail diagram; a loop.
notFor: Frames, connectors or circles (keep those clean); decorative doodles.

intent.en: Make each part feel like a thing drawn for the viewer, distinct from the clean structure around it.
intent.zh: 让每个部件像为观众手画的东西，和周围干净的结构区分开。

content.en: A title (≤ 14 / 6), an optional secondary line (≤ 30 / 12), the layer, a seed, rect or loop.
content.zh: 标题（≤ 14 / 6）、可选副行（≤ 30 / 12）、所属层、种子、方形或循环。

fits.zh: 总图或细节图里的系统部件；一个循环。

notFor.zh: 框、连线、圆（这些保持干净）；装饰性涂鸦。

en: Give every node its own fixed seed; two nodes with one seed look copied.
A loop is a smooth pill with clipped hachure, never a rough circle.
zh: 每个节点用自己固定的种子；同种子的两个节点像复制的。
循环是带裁剪排线的光滑药丸，不是粗糙圆。
